steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to OpenProject at http://127.0.0.1:8090/ with username admin and password exactly {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}. Verify that the authenticated application is open and report what page is visible.
02-report: In OpenProject, inspect Bench Project and report the exact subjects of its work packages that start with 'Seed:'; do not edit any work package.

03-create: Create a Task work package in Bench Project titled '{{runid}} Bench Work Package' with a description that includes the exact runid {{runid}}. Submit it, verify it exists with the requested type, project, title and description, and report its displayed #ID.

04-set: On the work package titled '{{runid}} Bench Work Package' in Bench Project, set the Assignee to the actual autocomplete dropdown option 'Bench Assignee' (do not merely type it), allow the inline edit to save, and verify the displayed assignee.

05-change: On work package {{03-create.work_package_id}} '{{runid}} Bench Work Package' in Bench Project, change its status to exactly 'In progress', wait for inline save, and verify the resulting displayed status.

06-set: On work package {{03-create.work_package_id}} '{{runid}} Bench Work Package' in Bench Project, set Finish date to 2026-12-31, let the inline edit save, and verify the displayed finish date is exactly 2026-12-31.

07-add: On work package {{03-create.work_package_id}} '{{runid}} Bench Work Package' in Bench Project, add a comment whose text includes the exact runid {{runid}}, submit it, and verify the posted comment text is visible on the work package.
